# formfactor <name> <pos xyz> <dir xyz> <size w h> <surface xyz> <normal xyz> <expected>
# Expected values are the exact vector form factor F = (1/(2 pi)) x sum over the four corners of
# acos(dot(u_i, u_i+1)) x normalize(cross(u_i, u_i+1)) in f64, followed by the contract clipping
# max((|F|^2 + dot(F, normal)) / (|F| + 1), 0), written with 6 significant digits.
# centred_parallel and far_small are on axis (z = |F|), so clipping reproduces |F| exactly;
# behind is on the non-emitting side and below_horizon clips at the receiver's horizon.
# cornell_floor and cornell_back_wall use the M3 Cornell light at CORNELL_LIGHT_Y = 5.088.
formfactor centred_parallel 0 0 0 0 0 -1 2 2 0 0 -1 0 0 1 0.554126
formfactor far_small 0 0 0 0 0 -1 0.1 0.1 0 0 -5 0 0 1 0.000127307
formfactor tilted_60 0 0 0 0 0 -1 2 2 0 0 -1 0.8660254 0 0.5 0.375851
formfactor behind 0 0 0 0 0 -1 2 2 0 0 1 0 0 -1 0
formfactor below_horizon 0 0 0 0 0 -1 2 2 3 0 -1 1 0 0 0
formfactor cornell_floor 2.78 5.088 2.795 0 -1 0 1.05 1.30 2.78 0 2.795 0 1 0 0.0164876
formfactor cornell_back_wall 2.78 5.088 2.795 0 -1 0 1.05 1.30 2.78 4.4 5.592 0 0 -1 0.0124405
formfactor corner_order 0 0 0 0 0 -1 3 1 0.5 0.3 -2 0 0 1 0.159840
